articles.title: Starwood Lands $483M CMBS Loan to Refi Single-Family Rental Portfolio
articles.narrative: Starwood Asset Management has secured a $482.5 million CMBS loan to refinance a portfolio of 1,749 single-family rental homes spread across 10 states. The floating-rate, interest-only financing was originated by Nomura Securities and is scheduled to mature in August 2028, with options for three 12-month extensions. The portfolio, which Starwood assembled between 2021 and 2022 for $674 million, was over 96% leased in April.

data_points.notable_features: Portfolio of single-family rental homes located across 10 states, with a significant concentration in Georgia, Arizona, and Florida. Average home size is 1,812 square feet, built in 1992.
data_points.project_notes: Starwood Asset Management previously acquired the homes for $674 million between 2021 and 2022.

articles.title: Extell Finalizes Deal to Buy 110 East 55th Street for $65M
articles.narrative: Extell Development has finalized the acquisition of 110 East 55th Street, a 19-story office building in Midtown, from the Parkoff Organization for $65 million. The transaction follows a pre-foreclosure suit filed against the property in May, alleging a loan default by Parkoff. This acquisition further expands Extell's portfolio of Midtown assets, with the developer having been in contract for the property since January.

data_points.address: 110 East 55th Street, New York City, NY
data_points.project_notes: An affiliate of JT Magen filed a pre-foreclosure suit in May, alleging Parkoff defaulted on a loan and owed $40.6 million in principal and interest.

articles.title: Terreno Realty Acquires Red Hook Warehouse for $26M
articles.narrative: Terreno Realty has acquired a 28,000-square-foot industrial warehouse property in Red Hook, Brooklyn, for $26.3 million from LBA Properties. The property, located on the East River waterfront, includes parking for 70 cars and two loading bays, and is currently leased to a maritime goods and services provider. This acquisition follows strong leasing fundamentals in the industrial sector, with significant year-over-year increases in leasing activity and declining vacancies.

data_points.notable_features: Located on the banks of the East River with parking for 70 cars and two loading bays.
data_points.project_notes: LBA Properties previously acquired the property in March 2025 for $7 million. Buckeye Partners acquired it in 2013 for $15.5 million and paid a $92.1 million real property transfer tax in late 2019.

articles.market_intelligence: Industrial sector leasing increased 11% year-over-year to 268.7 million square feet across the U.S. in Q2 2026, with vacancies dropping to 6.5%.

articles.title: Aircraft Finance Firm Buys Florida HQ Complex For $118M
articles.narrative: An aircraft finance firm has acquired the Cocomar Business Park, a three-building, 375,000-square-foot campus under construction in Coconut Creek, Florida, for $118 million. The campus, which is expected to be completed in the third quarter of this year, will serve as the company's new corporate headquarters. The seller, an affiliate of a Charleston-based real estate firm, had previously acquired the 35-acre site for $30.5 million last year.

data_points.address: 4733, 4763 and 4851 West Atlantic Boulevard, Coconut Creek, FL
data_points.notable_features: Three-building campus with 32-foot clear heights, 78 dock doors, and 313 parking spaces, including a small amount of office space and conference rooms.
data_points.project_notes: The 35-acre site was previously acquired for $30.5 million last year.

articles.title: PGIM Sells Delray Beach Assisted Living Community for at Least $140M
articles.narrative: Artemis Real Estate Partners has acquired The Arbor at Delray, a 207-unit assisted living facility in Delray Beach, Florida, from PGIM Real Estate for at least $140 million. Completed in 2023, the 224,951-square-foot community includes a recreational clubhouse and a nursing home. This transaction represents one of the largest retirement home sales in South Florida recently, reflecting strong demand in Palm Beach County where occupancy rates for assisted living facilities are nearing 90 percent.

data_points.address: 6595 Morikami Park Road, Delray Beach, FL
data_points.notable_features: Includes a 35,586-square-foot recreational clubhouse and a 51,461-square-foot nursing home.
data_points.project_notes: The 7.2-acre land parcel was previously acquired for $8.2 million in 2021, and a $45.7 million construction loan was secured from Comerica Bank.

articles.market_intelligence: The occupancy rate for assisted living facilities in Florida neared 90 percent in Q2 2026, with monthly rents averaging over $5,000. There has been an uptick in assisted living facilities in Palm Beach County this year.

articles.title: Jackson-Shaw Breaks Ground on 908,730 SF Industrial Project in Denton, Texas
articles.narrative: Jackson-Shaw has commenced construction on Horizon 35, a substantial industrial project spanning over 900,000 square feet in Denton, Texas. The initial phase will deliver three rear-load buildings totaling 543,550 square feet, featuring modern specifications such as high clear heights and extensive loading capabilities. This development aims to meet the growing demand for industrial space in the North Texas market.

data_points.notable_features: Phase I features 32- to 36-foot clear heights, dock-high loading doors, 18-by-20-foot drive-in doors, and ample car and trailer parking.

articles.title: Haven Housing Acquires 264-Unit Apartment Complex in Pflugerville, Texas
articles.narrative: California-based investment firm Haven Housing has acquired Wells Park Apartments, a 264-unit multifamily complex in Pflugerville, Texas. Built in 2018, the property features a strong amenity package including a pool, fitness center, and resident clubhouse. The transaction details, including the seller and sales price, were not disclosed.

data_points.notable_features: Amenities include a pool, fitness center, resident clubhouse, business center, and outdoor gathering spaces.

articles.title: Partners Capital Acquires 41,041 SF Shopping Center in McAllen, Texas
articles.narrative: Partners Capital, the investment arm of Partners Real Estate, has acquired Colonnade of McAllen, a 41,041-square-foot shopping center in McAllen, Texas. Built in 2004, the property was fully leased to a diverse mix of service-oriented tenants at the time of sale. The acquisition expands Partners Capital's retail portfolio in the region.

data_points.notable_features: Fully leased to a mix of service-oriented tenants.

articles.title: Base Power Signs 32,375 SF Industrial Lease in Frisco
articles.narrative: Base Power Inc., a home battery provider, has signed a 32,375-square-foot industrial lease for space within Building 3 at Frisco Trade Center. Dalfen Industrial, the locally based landlord, was represented by Lee & Associates in the transaction.

articles.title: Garden Communities Begins Leasing 211-Unit Apartment Complex in Roseland, New Jersey
articles.narrative: Garden Communities has commenced leasing at Gardens at Roseland, a new 211-unit apartment complex in Roseland, New Jersey. The property offers a mix of single-level and duplex one- and two-bedroom apartments, with rents starting at approximately $2,700 per month for a one-bedroom unit. Residents will have access to a variety of amenities including a pool, fitness center, entertainment room, fireside lounge, private workspaces, sports court, playground, and outdoor grilling and dining areas.

data_points.notable_features: Offers single-level and duplex apartments; amenities include a pool, fitness center, entertainment room, fireside lounge, private workspaces, sports court, playground, and outdoor grilling and dining stations.

articles.title: Newmark brokers 150,316-square-foot lease industrial lease in Forest Park
articles.narrative: Newmark has brokered a long-term, full-building industrial lease for Dynamic Manufacturing, encompassing 150,316 square feet at 7801 Industrial Drive in Forest Park, Illinois. The facility will be used for industrial warehousing, electrification, and manufacturing, supporting the tenant's business expansion and increasing its warehouse capacity. The property's fully air-conditioned warehouse and planned ESFR sprinkler system were significant factors in the tenant's decision.

data_points.notable_features: Features 4,509 square feet of office space, 24-foot clear heights, six interior loading docks, one drive-in door, parking for 120 vehicles, and a fully air-conditioned warehouse with a planned ESFR sprinkler system. Located approximately 10 miles west of downtown Chicago with immediate access to Interstates 290 and 294.

articles.title: Entre Commercial Realty closes 20,500-square-foot industrial lease in Wauconda
articles.narrative: Entre Commercial Realty has successfully brokered a 20,500-square-foot industrial lease in Wauconda, Illinois. The transaction involved a freestanding industrial facility, which was brought to full occupancy following its recent acquisition by an investment purchaser. This lease completes the investor's strategy for the property.

data_points.notable_features: Freestanding industrial facility with 20-foot clear heights, two exterior loading docks, and one drive-in door.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap brokers sale of 7-11 property in Cleburne
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of a 4,088-square-foot net-leased 7-Eleven property in Cleburne, TX. The property, built in 2021, is situated on 1.12 acres and is secured by a lease with nearly 10 years remaining. The asset is noted for its strong performance, ranking among the top 2.5% of 7-Eleven locations nationwide and the top 2% in Texas.

data_points.notable_features: Property is ranked among the top 2.5% of 7-Eleven locations nationwide and the top 2% in Texas.
data_points.project_notes: Secured by a lease with nearly 10 years remaining.

articles.title: Corpay’s Cross-Border Business Leases Prebuilt at Rudin’s 560 Lexington
articles.narrative: Corpay's Cross-Border business has signed an 11-year office lease for 17,778 square feet at 560 Lexington Avenue, a 22-story office tower in New York City's Plaza District owned by Rudin. The company, which specializes in foreign exchange and global payments, will relocate its headquarters to the entire 17th floor this fall. The deal highlights the appeal of the Plaza District and Rudin's successful prebuilt and amenity programs, which allowed for a quick move-in with minimal modifications to the space.

data_points.address: 560 Lexington Ave., New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Prebuilt space spanning the entire 17th floor of a 22-story office tower.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap’s Azzi Group Closes Value-Add Sale of West Hollywood Multifamily
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap's Azzi Group has facilitated the sale of a 30-unit multifamily property in West Hollywood for $7.98 million. The transaction provides the buyer with a value-add opportunity to renovate vacant units and improve operations, capitalizing on strong rental demand in the area due to limited housing supply and desirable location.

data_points.address: 1203 N. Kings Road, West Hollywood, CA
data_points.notable_features: Well-located asset with significant value-add potential.

articles.title: Northmarq Arranges $75M Acquisition Loan for Grocery-Anchored Queens Center
articles.narrative: Northmarq's New York Debt + Equity team secured a $75 million acquisition and redevelopment loan for the Whitestone Shopping Center in Queens, New York. The financing was arranged on behalf of BTF Whitestone LLC, which plans a significant transformation of the grocery-anchored retail center. The project aims to revitalize the property into a vibrant neighborhood retail destination, benefiting both existing tenants and the local community.

articles.title: SRS Arranges Sale of Newly Built Caliber Collision Property
articles.narrative: SRS Real Estate Partners has completed the $5.24 million sale of a newly constructed Caliber Collision property in Chula Vista, CA. The 16,832-square-foot asset, part of a larger retail development, was acquired by a Southern California-based family trust from a Southern California developer. The property features a 15-year corporate-guaranteed absolute triple net lease, attracting significant investor interest and selling above its asking price, reflecting a 5.5% cap rate. Its strategic location near auto dealerships and a dense population base positions the tenant for strong business.

data_points.notable_features: Newly built property with a 15-year corporate-guaranteed absolute triple net lease; located less than a mile from Interstate 805 and Chula Vista Crossings, a Kohl's-anchored retail center.
data_points.project_notes: Part of a new development with a total value of approximately $30 million, featuring other recognizable brands.

articles.title: NAI Hanson Tapped to Lease Former Barnes & Noble Headquarters
articles.narrative: NAI James E. Hanson has been appointed by First National Realty Management, LLC, as the exclusive leasing agent for the former Barnes & Noble world headquarters at 120 Mountainview Blvd. in Basking Ridge, NJ. The Class A office building offers a rare opportunity for a large block of space in a prime corporate corridor, with new ownership committed to reinvestment and providing a full suite of premium amenities.

data_points.notable_features: Features a two-story lobby, an onsite cafe, outdoor seating, a bocce court, and over 500 on-site parking spaces. Located near Interstates 78 and 287, providing access to Newark Liberty International Airport and New York City.

articles.title: CGI Merchant Had A-Rod's Backing And A $650M Fund. Then It Bought Trump's D.C. Hotel And It All Fell Apart
articles.narrative: CGI Merchant Group, a real estate investment firm, experienced significant financial difficulties and ultimately crumbled following its acquisition of the Trump International Hotel in Washington D. D. The firm had previously raised a substantial $650 million fund with backing from notable investors, but the high-profile hotel purchase appears to have been a pivotal factor in its downfall.

articles.title: Oceanwide Buyers Want Tax Incentives For 184-Room Hotel
articles.narrative: The buyers of the Oceanwide Plaza project are seeking city tax incentives to facilitate the completion of the stalled mixed-use development, which includes a hotel, residential units, and retail space. The project has faced significant delays, and the new ownership is looking for public support to move forward with construction.

data_points.project_notes: Project includes hotel, residential, and retail components. Buyers are seeking city tax incentives to complete the stalled development.

articles.title: Builders Turning To Prefab Solutions As Speed To Delivery Becomes Critical Consideration
articles.narrative: The article highlights a growing trend among builders to adopt prefabricated and modular construction solutions, driven primarily by the critical need for accelerated project delivery. While cost considerations remain relevant, the speed advantage offered by prefab methods is increasingly outweighing traditional construction approaches, particularly in sectors like data centers and housing where rapid deployment is essential.

articles.title: Fake-Plant Maker Shuttering Hialeah Warehouse, Moving To Lakeland
articles.narrative: Nearly Natural, a manufacturer of artificial plants, is closing its Hialeah warehouse and relocating its operations to Lakeland, Florida. This move will result in the layoff of 60 employees.

articles.title: Maturing Debt Triggers Wave of Distressed Hotel Sales Across California
articles.narrative: California's hotel market is experiencing a significant increase in sales activity, with nearly 30% of transactions involving lenders, indicating a wave of distressed asset dispositions. This trend is primarily driven by maturing debt and rising interest rates, which are making it difficult for owners to refinance or service existing loans. Buyers are increasingly opportunistic, seeking properties at discounted values, particularly in markets with strong underlying tourism fundamentals.
